source.statement: SELECT SALE_ID, DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, QTY, AMOUNT, COST FROM SALES
SELECT SNAPSHOT_DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, ON_HAND FROM STOCK
SELECT DATE_KEY, CAL_DATE, CAL_YEAR, CAL_MONTH FROM CAL
SELECT STORE_KEY, STORE_NAME, REGION, MANAGER_KEY FROM STORE
SELECT PRODUCT_KEY, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_KEY FROM PRODUCT

SELECT s.SALE_ID, s.AMOUNT, s.COST, s.QTY, st.REGION, st.STORE_NAME, c.CAL_MONTH, c.CAL_YEAR, m.MANAGER_NAME FROM SALES s LEFT JOIN STORE st ON st.STORE_KEY = s.STORE_KEY LEFT JOIN CAL c ON c.DATE_KEY = s.DATE_KEY LEFT JOIN MGR m ON m.MANAGER_KEY = st.MANAGER_KEY

-- page fact for page 'Rollup' (scaffold-page-fact.py). Edit freely; keep each @slicers hook comment inside its WHERE clause.
-- grain: Product[Category]
-- SUM_AMOUNT = SUM(Sales.Amount) on Sales [USERELATIONSHIP]
-- SUM_QTY = SUM(Sales.Qty) on Sales [USERELATIONSHIP]
-- TODO Orders: DAX function DISTINCTCOUNT is not decomposed into additive components
--     DISTINCTCOUNT(Sales[Sale Id])
WITH
pfs_sales AS (
  SELECT SALE_ID, DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, QTY, AMOUNT, COST FROM SALES
),
pfs_product AS (
  SELECT PRODUCT_KEY, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_KEY FROM PRODUCT
),
pfs_rollup AS (
  SELECT CHILD_PRODUCT_KEY, PARENT_PRODUCT_KEY FROM ROLLUP_MAP
),
pfs_supplier AS (
  SELECT SUPPLIER_KEY, SUPPLIER_NAME FROM SUPPLIER
),
agg_sales_ur1 AS (
  SELECT
    j2."CATEGORY" AS "G_CATEGORY",
    SUM(f."AMOUNT") AS "SUM_AMOUNT",
    SUM(f."QTY") AS "SUM_QTY"
  FROM pfs_sales f
  LEFT JOIN pfs_rollup j1 ON j1."CHILD_PRODUCT_KEY" = f."PRODUCT_KEY"
  LEFT JOIN pfs_product j2 ON j2."PRODUCT_KEY" = j1."PARENT_PRODUCT_KEY"
  WHERE 1 = 1
    /*@slicers fact="Sales" alias="f" userelationship="'Rollup'[Child Product Key]|'Sales'[Product Key]" sources="Product=pfs_product;Rollup=pfs_rollup;Supplier=pfs_supplier"*/
  GROUP BY j2."CATEGORY"
)
SELECT
  "G_CATEGORY",
  "SUM_AMOUNT",
  "SUM_QTY",
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "TODO_ORDERS"
FROM agg_sales_ur1

-- page fact for page 'Sales Overview' (scaffold-page-fact.py). Edit freely; keep each @slicers hook comment inside its WHERE clause.
-- grain: Store[Region], Calendar[Month]
-- SUM_AMOUNT = SUM(Sales.Amount) on Sales
-- SUM_COST = SUM(Sales.Cost) on Sales
-- SUM_QTY = SUM(Sales.Qty) on Sales
-- TODO West Sales: CALCULATE replaces the filter on Store[Region], a grouping column of this page: the page fact applies that filter to every component, so this measure needs its own handling (add KEEPFILTERS in the source if an intersection is meant, or model it by hand)
--     CALCULATE([Sales Amount], Store[Region] = "West")
WITH
pfs_sales AS (
  SELECT SALE_ID, DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, QTY, AMOUNT, COST FROM SALES
),
pfs_calendar AS (
  SELECT DATE_KEY, CAL_DATE, CAL_YEAR, CAL_MONTH FROM CAL
),
pfs_manager AS (
  SELECT MANAGER_KEY, MANAGER_NAME FROM MGR
),
pfs_product AS (
  SELECT PRODUCT_KEY, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_KEY FROM PRODUCT
),
pfs_store AS (
  SELECT STORE_KEY, STORE_NAME, REGION, MANAGER_KEY FROM STORE
),
pfs_supplier AS (
  SELECT SUPPLIER_KEY, SUPPLIER_NAME FROM SUPPLIER
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    j2."REGION" AS "G_REGION",
    j1."CAL_MONTH" AS "G_MONTH",
    SUM(f."AMOUNT") AS "SUM_AMOUNT",
    SUM(f."COST") AS "SUM_COST",
    SUM(f."QTY") AS "SUM_QTY"
  FROM pfs_sales f
  LEFT JOIN pfs_calendar j1 ON j1."DATE_KEY" = f."DATE_KEY"
  LEFT JOIN pfs_store j2 ON j2."STORE_KEY" = f."STORE_KEY"
  WHERE 1 = 1
    /*@slicers fact="Sales" alias="f" sources="Calendar=pfs_calendar;Manager=pfs_manager;Product=pfs_product;Store=pfs_store;Supplier=pfs_supplier"*/
  GROUP BY j2."REGION", j1."CAL_MONTH"
)
SELECT
  "G_REGION",
  "G_MONTH",
  "SUM_AMOUNT",
  "SUM_COST",
  "SUM_QTY",
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "TODO_WEST_SALES"
FROM agg_sales

-- page fact for page 'Stock Cover' (scaffold-page-fact.py). Edit freely; keep each @slicers hook comment inside its WHERE clause.
-- grain: Product[Category], Store[Store Name]
-- SUM_ON_HAND = SUM(Stock.On Hand) on Stock
-- SUM_QTY = SUM(Sales.Qty) on Sales
-- SUM_ON_HAND_2 = SUM(Stock.On Hand) WHERE Store.Manager Key IS NULL on Stock
WITH
pfs_sales AS (
  SELECT SALE_ID, DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, QTY, AMOUNT, COST FROM SALES
),
pfs_stock AS (
  SELECT SNAPSHOT_DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, ON_HAND FROM STOCK
),
pfs_manager AS (
  SELECT MANAGER_KEY, MANAGER_NAME FROM MGR
),
pfs_product AS (
  SELECT PRODUCT_KEY, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_KEY FROM PRODUCT
),
pfs_store AS (
  SELECT STORE_KEY, STORE_NAME, REGION, MANAGER_KEY FROM STORE
),
pfs_supplier AS (
  SELECT SUPPLIER_KEY, SUPPLIER_NAME FROM SUPPLIER
),
agg_stock AS (
  SELECT
    j1."CATEGORY" AS "G_CATEGORY",
    j2."STORE_NAME" AS "G_STORE_NAME",
    SUM(f."ON_HAND") AS "SUM_ON_HAND",
    SUM(CASE WHEN j2."MANAGER_KEY" IS NULL THEN f."ON_HAND" END) AS "SUM_ON_HAND_2"
  FROM pfs_stock f
  LEFT JOIN pfs_product j1 ON j1."PRODUCT_KEY" = f."PRODUCT_KEY"
  LEFT JOIN pfs_store j2 ON j2."STORE_KEY" = f."STORE_KEY"
  WHERE 1 = 1
    AND f."PRODUCT_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_product sj1 WHERE sj1."SUPPLIER_KEY" IN (SELECT sj2."SUPPLIER_KEY" FROM pfs_supplier sj2 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj2."SUPPLIER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN ('Acme', 'Globex')))
    /*@slicers fact="Stock" alias="f" sources="Manager=pfs_manager;Product=pfs_product;Sales=pfs_sales;Store=pfs_store;Supplier=pfs_supplier"*/
  GROUP BY j1."CATEGORY", j2."STORE_NAME"
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    j1."CATEGORY" AS "G_CATEGORY",
    j2."STORE_NAME" AS "G_STORE_NAME",
    SUM(f."QTY") AS "SUM_QTY"
  FROM pfs_sales f
  LEFT JOIN pfs_product j1 ON j1."PRODUCT_KEY" = f."PRODUCT_KEY"
  LEFT JOIN pfs_store j2 ON j2."STORE_KEY" = f."STORE_KEY"
  WHERE 1 = 1
    AND f."PRODUCT_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_product sj1 WHERE sj1."SUPPLIER_KEY" IN (SELECT sj2."SUPPLIER_KEY" FROM pfs_supplier sj2 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj2."SUPPLIER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN ('Acme', 'Globex')))
    /*@slicers fact="Sales" alias="f" sources="Manager=pfs_manager;Product=pfs_product;Stock=pfs_stock;Store=pfs_store;Supplier=pfs_supplier"*/
  GROUP BY j1."CATEGORY", j2."STORE_NAME"
)
SELECT
  "G_CATEGORY",
  "G_STORE_NAME",
  SUM("SUM_ON_HAND") AS "SUM_ON_HAND",
  SUM("SUM_QTY") AS "SUM_QTY",
  SUM("SUM_ON_HAND_2") AS "SUM_ON_HAND_2"
FROM (
  SELECT "G_CATEGORY", "G_STORE_NAME", "SUM_ON_HAND", NULL AS "SUM_QTY", "SUM_ON_HAND_2" FROM agg_stock
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "G_CATEGORY", "G_STORE_NAME", NULL AS "SUM_ON_HAND", "SUM_QTY", NULL AS "SUM_ON_HAND_2" FROM agg_sales
) u
GROUP BY "G_CATEGORY", "G_STORE_NAME"
